pr_title: Fix reporting of deprecated arguments for modules
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY
Make `removed_at_date` and `removed_in_version` in argument spec working again. Also adds some basic tests so this shouldn't happen again so easily.

Fixes #79680.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
lib/ansible/module_utils/common/arg_spec.py

issue_context.title: removed_at_date and removed_in_version in argument spec stopped working
issue_context.body:
### Summary

This was likely caused by the refactoring in abacf6a108b038571a0c3daeae63da0897c8fcb6; the old code was calling `list_deprecations()` from `AnsibleModule._handle_no_log_values()`, and the new code renamed the function to `_list_deprecations()`, but doesn't seem to call it *at all*. (There also seem to be no integration tests for this, so this went unnoticed.)

Ref: https://github.com/ansible-collections/community.zabbix/issues/857#issuecomment-1354637050

@felixfontein it seems the commit you posted in the issue description is not valid, can you double check?
@mkrizek not sure what I did, but the commit is the merge commit of https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/73703/files, i.e. abacf6a108b038571a0c3daeae63da0897c8fcb6. I'll update the description.

review_comments: One thing I'm not really happy about is that `name` is used as an indicator that it is an alias deprecation. I would probably replace `name` by `alias`, but that would be a larger change that shouldn't happen in this PR IMO.
It doesn't look like `name` is used for anything other than aliases - `msg` is used for deprecated parameters. Renaming it (or consolidating with msg) would be nice.

I've started working on a PR to improve this, and then I noticed that there are probably a lot more bugs in there when it comes to suboptions (and using aliases for the option that you have suboptions of), both for parameter deprecation and for alias deprecation. This will be fun...
Actually parameter deprecation works fine, it's alias deprecation that only work on toplevel.

I tried to fix some long-term issues with suboptions in https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/76578/files too. I never got a review on that, so if you spot any more related issues I'd be happy to fix/review yours.
